public_rationale: On October 21, 2026, Google Cloud announced that it was launching OpenAI models in its model garden [e1]. It said customers would purchase access through Google Cloud Marketplace [e1]. This documents commercial activity shortly before the evaluation date [e1].
limitations: The packet establishes no cessation of OpenAI's operations and compute payments, or resulting supplier revenue effect.
Continued commercial activity does not refute the conditional forecast or establish OpenAI's solvency.
The claimed 70% share of Microsoft's AI revenue remains unverified against figures with a consistent period and denominator.
The claim supplies no deadline, numerical materiality threshold or post-failure measurement window.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If OpenAI dies, hyperscaler revenues will drop materially, since it is 70% of Microsoft's AI revenue.
conditions: if OpenAI is allowed to die

statement.excerpt: At 70% of Microsoft’s AI revenues largely from its tens of billions of dollars’ worth of compute spend, OpenAI will represent a material drop in hyperscaler revenues, and somebody will have to be blamed.

from_speaker: a material drop in hyperscaler revenues
OpenAI could simply be allowed to run out of money
our_interpretation: The forecast applies if OpenAI ceases operating and stops paying for compute. Financial distress or a restructuring that preserves payments does not alone satisfy that condition.
A material drop means a financially significant loss of realized hyperscaler revenue attributable to OpenAI's failure, allowing for replacement customers and transferred workloads.
The 70% statement is a separate historical premise. It requires a consistent Microsoft AI revenue denominator and reporting period.
No accounting basis, numerical materiality threshold or post-failure observation window is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After the condition occurs, supplier disclosures establish a financially significant revenue loss caused by OpenAI's failure. The 70% premise requires separate verification using matched revenue figures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the condition occurs, sufficiently complete supplier disclosures show that replacement business or continued payments prevent a material revenue loss. Continued OpenAI operations do not contradict the conditional forecast.
